description: List invoices, filterable by status, number, date range and contact. Status: 50 deactivated recurring, 100 draft, 200 open/due, 750 partially paid, 1000 paid. sevdesk: GET /Invoice.

contact_id.description: Only invoices for this contact id.

count_all.description: If true, the response also carries `total`, the full match count.

embed.description: Comma-separated nested resources to expand inline, e.g. contact,category.

end_date.description: Only invoices dated on or before this, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

invoice_number.description: Only the invoice with this number.

invoice_type.description: Only this type: RE normal, WKR recurring, SR cancellation, MA reminder, TR partial, AR advance, ER final.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip, for paging.

start_date.description: Only invoices dated on or after this, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

status.description: Only invoices with this status code.

name: sevdesk_list_invoices
title: List invoices
